claims.text: Many reviewers say it leaves hair shiny, soft, and smooth.
A common complaint is that it produces little to no lather.
Several reviewers praise the scent as pleasant and not overwhelming.
Some reviewers report a bad or off smell, including one who suspected an old product.
Some say it dries out hair or leaves residue, while others find it non-drying and strengthening.
